## New in 1.2
- Plan marketing content in the calendar, move posts through stages on the board, and track publishing by social account. - Browse releases, listing details, screenshots, customer reviews, TestFlight feedback, and available analytics from an app’s App Store tab. Import screenshots or turn localized release notes into a draft. - Create and share a customizable PNG showcase of your app lineup. - See upcoming posts on the dashboard, pin frequently used social accounts, and rename or switch workspaces from the sidebar. - Organize reusable media in the shared asset library and group screenshots by platform.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 27.2 or later.

## New in 1.1
- Start from a visual workspace dashboard with a featured item, app artwork, draft previews, and shortcuts to the records you use. - See the next seven days of publishing plans, filter by channel, and spot failed or uncertain deliveries. Manual plans and API schedules are labeled separately. - Use native macOS menus and keyboard shortcuts to open recent workspaces, create records, save, and search. Open Settings with Command–comma. - Right-click apps, content, and accounts to open records, copy saved text or handles, view published links, and reconnect accounts. - Move between Write, Publish, and Details in the composer while keeping the title and save state visible. - Switch workspaces with unsaved edits without losing your selected destination. If the destination can’t be opened, the current editor stays open. - A refreshed app icon.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 27.2 or later.
